preconditions.description: The input is a single integer n where 1 ≤ n ≤ 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly two nonempty strings s and p separated by a single space.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() for c in s) and all(c.isalpha() for c in p)
postconditions.description: Both strings s and p consist only of alphabetic characters (a-z, A-Z).
Both strings s and p have length at most 200.
Both strings s and p are nonempty.
The number of occurrences of p as a subsequence in s is exactly n.
